name: Semantic Locators Over CSS Selectors
task: Write a test for the login flow on https://www.saucedemo.com
passCriteria: Uses getByRole(), getByLabel(), getByPlaceholder(), getByText(), or [data-test] attributes for username, password, and login button
No CSS class selectors, XPath, or nth-child selectors used
Test actually performs login flow (fills fields and clicks button)
Verifies login succeeded by checking URL change or inventory page content
failCriteria: Test that doesn't actually verify login outcome (no assertion after clicking login)
